text: Three things that cancer hates. Three things it really cannot tolerate. Pay attention. First, an alkaline environment. When the inside of your body is acidic, cancer develops more easily. Fungi, parasites, bad bacteria, and toxins create that acidic environment. You need to cleanse the body and make it alkaline. A glass of water with lemon and a pinch of baking soda every morning helps detoxify, eliminate heavy metals, and alkalize your body. The pharmaceutical industry doesn't talk about this because it can't be patented. Second, oxygen. Cancer hates oxygen. When you move, you breathe deeper. The heart beats stronger and carries oxygen to every cell. You don't need to train hard. Walk, move, do some physical activity. Movement is medicine for your body and your mind. Third, lack of sugar. Cancer needs glucose to grow. We live in a world full of excess carbohydrates, breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Only carbohydrates. Rice, potatoes, boxed juices, flowers. Everything turns into sugar in the blood. Cancer feeds on that excess. Reduce refined carbohydrates and sugar, and you take away cancer's favorite fuel. Save this video and share it with someone who needs it. But I want you to understand something. There's a fourth thing that cancer hates, and almost nobody mentions it. Calmness. Chronic stress suppresses your immune system, which is exactly the system in charge of detecting and destroying damaged cells before they multiply. Anxiety generates constant inflammation, which is the ground where cancer thrives. The emotions you accumulate without releasing acidify your body from within. You can alkalize, move, and reduce sugar. If you live stressed, your immune system stays asleep. Write in the comments, health, if you're going to start with at least one of these three. And if you want to calm what weakens your body from within and live with a strong immune system. I've been learning in silence for more than twenty years how to do it. And everything I know is inside the path. Back to calmness. The link is in my profile.
